title: Offline resilience and privacy verification check
description: Implement security and privacy verification test in tests/test_privacy_and_offline.py ensuring that the application operates with zero external network requests, does not persist raw facial images to disk, and protects driver privacy (PRD FR-10 & 11).
acceptanceCriteria: Verifies that no outbound HTTP/HTTPS network connections are attempted during monitoring
Verifies that no raw facial images or video recordings are saved to disk by default
Verifies that event logs contain only timestamps and status event types without sensitive facial embeddings
Confirms that clearing logs permanently erases stored event records

steps.description: Create offline inspection test in tests/test_privacy_and_offline.py
steps.details: Mock urllib, requests, and socket network calls to assert that core vision, state machine, and alerts make zero outbound internet requests.

steps.description: Inspect file system writes during active monitoring
steps.details: Run 100 frames through the pipeline and inspect disk writes to confirm no image/video files (e.g. .jpg, .png, .mp4) are generated.
Inspect generated log records to verify no user identifiers, biometric points, or raw facial crops are logged.
Execute pytest and verify 100% compliance with privacy acceptance criteria.

technicalNotes: Strictly satisfies PRD FR-10: zero cloud upload and local privacy protection.
Verify mock sockets fail fast if an unintended external ping is triggered.
